card.line: Rome was the great capital of the empire in New Testament times, and the city where Paul came as a prisoner to preach the gospel.

moments.title: Jews Sent Out of Rome
moments.text: Paul met Aquila and Priscilla in Corinth. They had recently come from Italy because Claudius ordered all the Jews to leave Rome. They worked with Paul as tentmakers.

moments.title: Paul Longs to See Rome
moments.text: Paul decided in the Spirit to go to Jerusalem. He said that after that he must see Rome as well.

moments.title: The Lord Sends Paul to Rome
moments.text: After Paul was taken into the barracks, the Lord stood near him in the night. He told Paul to take courage, because he must testify in Rome as he had in Jerusalem.

moments.title: Paul Arrives in Rome
moments.text: Brothers met Paul on the road, and he was encouraged and thanked God. In Rome he was allowed to stay by himself with a soldier guarding him. Soon he called the Jewish leaders together and told them why he was bound with a chain.

moments.title: Paul Writes to the Romans
moments.text: Paul wrote to the believers in Rome, who were loved by God and called to be saints. He was eager to preach the gospel to them and said he was not ashamed of it.
